about_short_description.short_description: PredictLeads provides business intelligence via clean APIs.

product.name: Company Intelligence Data Platform
product.description: Structured company intelligence covering firmographics, company activity, hiring, technologies, products, business relationships, and market signals for AI and business applications.

product.name: Companies Dataset
product.description: Firmographic and corporate-structure data on more than 120 million companies, including locations, revenue ranges, headcount, NAICS codes, websites, parent companies, subsidiaries, and lookalikes.

product.name: News Events Dataset
product.description: Structured and categorized company news from more than 20 million sources, covering events such as funding, product launches, partnerships, acquisitions, and geographic expansion.

product.name: Job Openings Dataset
product.description: Global job-posting data sourced from company career pages and ATS integrations, with job descriptions, locations, salaries, seniority, contract types, O*NET codes, and historical timestamps.

product.name: Technologies Dataset
product.description: Technographic data identifying technologies used by companies, with technology categories, descriptions, pricing information, and detection history across websites, DNS records, and job postings.

product.name: Products Dataset
product.description: Structured data on products and offerings extracted from company product, solutions, and feature pages, including product names, descriptions, categories, source URLs, and company domains.
